# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.volta/bin/volta
# args: 
Displays the current toolchain

Usage: volta list [OPTIONS] [tool]

Arguments:
  [tool]
          The tool to lookup - `all`, `node`, `npm`, `yarn`, `pnpm`, or the name of a package or
          binary

Options:
      --format <FORMAT>
          Specify the output format.
          
          Defaults to `human` for TTYs, `plain` otherwise.
          
          [possible values: human, plain]

  -c, --current
          Show the currently-active tool(s).
          
          Equivalent to `volta list` when not specifying a specific tool.

  -d, --default
          Show your default tool(s)

      --verbose
          Enables verbose diagnostics

      --very-verbose
          Enables trace-level diagnostics

      --quiet
          Prevents unnecessary output

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
